purpose: Two generated real-data task diagnostics; not an ID benchmark score or teacher collection campaign. Inspect complete solver traces and deterministic artifact grades.

results.finding: Passed all 18 summary fields and every FASTA/TSV artifact check. Trace runs SPAdes and minimap2 on observed reads; solver repairs its mate-header parsing, TSV delimiter and aligned-contig counting errors before completion.
results.review_limits: Two selected tasks, one attempt each; no estimate of benchmark accuracy or general training benefit. No full-weight revision or rendered chat-template confirmation was exposed by the service.

results.finding: Native reward remains 0: six correct summary values were written as six separate records instead of one id=comparison record. All seven saved TSVs match canonical outputs under unchanged tolerances in a separate read-only comparison; no formal regrade.

read_only_artifact_comparison.method: Read-only csv.DictReader stream over saved TSVs against reference.json expected rows; exact headers, IDs, integer values and nulls; number fields checked using declared abs(actual-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference).
read_only_artifact_comparison.limitation: The native verifier stopped at record_schema, so this independent comparison does not change or assert the formal reward.

results.review_limits: Two selected tasks, one attempt each; no estimate of benchmark accuracy or general training benefit. No full-weight revision or rendered chat-template confirmation was exposed by the service.

trace_findings: Both solvers inspect authentic input formats and execute the actual pinned scientific packages. No recorded command accesses private /tests, /solution or reference.json.
Both spend early turns finding installed binaries under /opt/bio/bin because the interactive terminal PATH omits that directory.
Assembly recovers from self-generated parsing and output-format mistakes. RNA recovers from R syntax/assertion errors and fits the specified interaction model.
RNA self-checks repeat its mistaken JSON record structure; existing wording gives the comparison ID but a prominent schema/example would remove avoidable uncertainty.

The schema-first verifier returns before artifact checks on the RNA failure; future diagnostics should report artifact checks even when the summary schema is invalid, while preserving the binary reward.

next_interface_changes.action: Make the native tool environment discoverable in the actual login shell and validate command -v under the agent terminal.
State the exact expected record IDs and show a value-free output shape or JSON Schema; retain the current numerical contract.
Retain summary-schema failure and also report complete artifact checks; never promote a failed original attempt or relax tolerances to pass it.

interpretation: The two traces demonstrate intended scientific tool workflows within the budget. One strict success and one schema failure do not establish general solvability, benchmark coverage or training benefit.
